metadata.description: Gradual from Regensburg (St Emmeram), about 1000; German neumes of the St Gall type without a staff, with significative letters and episemas. The gradual of the mass for 1 January, f. 10v.
metadata.title: Graduale
metadata.transcription: Read sign by sign from the Munich Digitization Center's image of f. 10v (2600 px wide), by two independent readers, October and November 2026; see research/diffusa-est/staff-readings/README.md.
